name: City One-Bedroom
author: Companion Intelligence
style: A mid-rise of pale render on a city street, five floors under a flat roof with a stair head, shops behind tall shopfront glass on the ground floor, a teal lobby door in the stair core, charcoal-framed windows and a steel-railed balcony band on every floor above; the one-bedroom apartment is the street-side bay of the first floor up, about 58 square metres for a couple who both work from home, with a short entry hall, an open living room and kitchen that open onto the street balcony, a desk nook by a west window, a bedroom and bathroom at the back and a laundry closet, its neighbours' flats closed beside it and behind it
